prompt: which country did best with covid

answer.finalSql: SELECT "Country/Region" AS country, SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS total_deaths FROM "b3ce316e-d9e5-4279-89d7-bf42ab0d68fb" GROUP BY "Country/Region" ORDER BY total_deaths ASC LIMIT 20
answer.assistantText: This lists the 20 countries with the fewest total COVID deaths across all dates in the global deaths dataset. Totals are not adjusted for population, so small countries will rank high simply because they are small. Some countries may appear with very low counts because they report few deaths or report poorly.
